name: Boots Essentials Cucumber Moisturising Cream 100ml (International)
description:
Boots Essentials Cucumber Moisturising Cream 100ml (International)

Description:
Nourish and hydrate your skin with the Boots Essentials Cucumber Moisturising Cream. Enriched with soothing cucumber and vitamins, this cream provides long-lasting moisture while calming and revitalizing the skin.

Key Features:

Soothing & Refreshing: Cucumber and vitamins help calm and refresh the skin.

Moisturizing: Provides deep and long-lasting hydration for soft, smooth skin.

Suitable for All Skin Types: Gentle formula for everyday use.

Made in Bulgaria

Ideal for maintaining healthy, hydrated, and refreshed skin as part of your daily skincare routine.
